provenance_quote: The extracellular alkaline protease produced by Pseudomonas aeruginosa is secreted by a specific pathway, independent of the pathway used by most of the other extracellular proteins of this organism.
notes: UniProt Q03023 = AprA serralysin, P. aeruginosa PAO1, locus PA1249, Secreted; matches gene/organism/locus. DOI 10.1111/j.1365-2958.1991.tb02128.x = PMID 1904127 (Guzzo 1991), shows AprA secreted via PrtDEF/HlyBD T1SS. confirmed.

provenance_quote: Secretion of RsaA to the cell surface relies on an uncleaved C-terminal secretion signal. ... These components are part of a type I secretion system involving an ABC transporter protein.
notes: UniProt P35828 = S-layer RsaA, C. crescentus CB15, locus CC_1007, 'Secreted by an ABC transporter (type I) secretion apparatus'. DOI 10.1128/JB.180.12.3062-3069.1998 = PMID 9620954 (Awram & Smit 1998). All identifiers match. confirmed.

provenance_quote: secretion of B.pertussis adenylate cyclase and haemolysin requires the expression of additional genes. The gene products of cyaB and cyaD are highly similar to HlyB and HlyD
notes: Real T1SS substrate (cyclolysin/adenylate-cyclase-haemolysin, RTX), secreted via cyaBDE ~ HlyBD. BUT ledger organism says Bordetella bronchiseptica RB50; UniProt P0DKX7 is Bordetella pertussis Tohama I, locus BP0760, and NCBI confirms genome BX470248 = B. pertussis Tohama I (not B. bronchiseptica). Organism field disagrees with uniprot+locus+genome. fix: organism should be Bordetella pertussis (strain Tohama I). DOI 10.1002/j.1460-2075.1988.tb03288.x = PMID 2905265, resolves (Crossref + PubMed).

provenance_quote: PrtA, which shows homology to the Erwinia chrysanthemi metalloproteases, is efficiently secreted by E. coli cells carrying the E. chrysanthemi ABC exporter PrtD (ABC protein)-PrtE (MFP)-PrtF (OMP).
notes: Real secreted serralysin/T1SS metalloprotease. BUT ledger organism says Dickeya chrysanthemi; UniProt Q7N8R3 is Photorhabdus laumondii subsp. laumondii TT01, locus plu0655, genome BX470251 = Photorhabdus (not Dickeya). Organism field mismatches uniprot/locus/genome. fix: organism should be Photorhabdus laumondii (strain TT01). Cited ref PMID 9244262 (Akatsuka 1997) supports PrtD/E/F T1SS secretion of homologous serralysins; quote verbatim.

provenance_quote: Secreted, probably secreted via the associated Type 1 transporter encoded by aprDEF.
notes: Real T1SS metalloprotease AprA. BUT ledger organism says P. aeruginosa PAO1; UniProt Q1ID47 is Pseudomonas entomophila L48, locus PSEEN1550, genome CT573326 = P. entomophila L48 (not P. aeruginosa). Organism field mismatches uniprot/locus/genome. fix: organism should be Pseudomonas entomophila (strain L48). UniProt annotates T1 secretion via aprDEF; cited PMID 1904127 is the homologous P. aeruginosa AprA T1SS paper (DOI resolves).

provenance_quote: a unique exporter, the Lip apparatus, in S. marcescens secretes both LipA and PrtA.
notes: UniProt P23694 = serralysin/extracellular metalloproteinase, Serratia marcescens, Secreted. DOI 10.1128/jb.179.15.4754-4760.1997 = PMID 9244262 (Akatsuka 1997); S. marcescens PrtA/serralysin secreted by ABC (Lip) exporter, a T1SS. Locus AAG739_RS16605 / genome NZ_JBCGCZ010000007.1 consistent with S. marcescens. confirmed.

provenance_quote: The genes of the apxI operon will have the designations apxIC, apxIA, apxIB, and apxID for the activator, the structural gene and the two secretion genes respectively.
notes: UniProt P55128 = ApxIA RTX toxin (TC 1.C.11), A. pleuropneumoniae, Secreted. DOI 10.1099/00221287-139-8-1723 = PMID 8409915 (Frey 1993); apxIA structural gene, apxIB/apxID secretion genes (RTX/T1SS). Quote verbatim. confirmed.

provenance_quote: Actinobacillus pleuropneumoniae haemolysin II is secreted from Escherichia coli by A. pleuropneumoniae pleurotoxin secretion gene products
notes: UniProt P15377 = ApxIIA RTX toxin (TC 1.C.11), A. pleuropneumoniae, Secreted. DOI 10.1016/0378-1097(93)90039-5 (Macdonald 1993, FEMS Microbiol Lett 109:317-322) resolves via Crossref (not indexed in PubMed, so id-convert returned no PMID); title verbatim confirms ApxII T1SS secretion. ApxII secreted via apxIB/apxID per Frey review (PMID 8409915). confirmed.

provenance_quote: we found that ApxIII could be secreted from E. coli by the heterologous RTX transporter proteins HlyB and HlyD... the apxIIIA gene coded for the structural RTX toxin
notes: UniProt P55131 = ApxIIIA RTX toxin (TC 1.C.11), A. pleuropneumoniae, Secreted. DOI 10.1128/iai.61.3.947-954.1993 = PMID 8432615 (Jansen 1993); ApxIII secreted by HlyB/HlyD (RTX/T1SS); apxIIIA structural toxin. Quote verbatim. confirmed.

provenance_quote: HasA has a C-terminal targeting sequence and is secreted by a specific ATP binding cassette (ABC) transporter consisting of three proteins
notes: UniProt Q54450 = Hemophore HasA, Serratia marcescens, Secreted. DOI 10.1128/jb.176.17.5372-5377.1994 = PMID 8071214 (Letoffe 1994); HasA secreted by ABC (T1SS) transporter. Quote verbatim. Locus BVG90_RS01585 / NZ_CP018927.1 consistent with S. marcescens. confirmed.

provenance_quote: All four hemolysin cistrons (transcriptional order, C, A, B, and D) were encoded on the same DNA strand, and their predicted molecular masses were, respectively, 19.7, 109.8, 79.9, and 54.6 kilodaltons.
notes: UniProt P08715 = E. coli HlyA (RTX alpha-hemolysin, plasmid pHLY152 variant), Secreted; matches gene/organism. DOI 10.1128/jb.163.1.94-105.1985 = PMID 3891743 (Felmlee 1985) is the chromosomal hlyCABD sequence (B and D are the canonical T1SS transport genes); HlyA is the prototypic T1SS/RTX substrate. Note: accession is the plasmid HlyA while ref is the chromosomal determinant; same protein/secretion biology. confirmed (medium).

provenance_quote: a heteroplasmid complementation system was developed that permits secretion of the leukotoxin from cells expressing the hemolysin transport proteins HlyB and HlyD
notes: UniProt P0C082 = Leukotoxin LktA, Mannheimia (Pasteurella) haemolytica, Secreted; 'export signal recognized by ABC transporter complex LktBD' (RTX/T1SS). DOI 10.1128/jb.172.5.2343-2350.1990 = PMID 2185213 (Highlander 1990). Quote verbatim. Locus B824_RS12000 / NZ_CP006957.3 consistent with M. haemolytica. confirmed.

provenance_quote: an outer membrane channel-forming protein, TolC, is required for toxin secretion... requires a TolC-like protein for LtxA secretion
notes: UniProt P16462 = Leukotoxin LtxA, Aggregatibacter actinomycetemcomitans, RTX (TC 1.C.11), secreted (TolC-dependent). DOI 10.1016/j.gene.2006.10.004 = PMID 17116373 (Crosby & Kachlany 2006); TolC-like TdeA required for LtxA secretion (RTX/T1SS). Quote verbatim. Locus IMM52_RS00555 / NZ_JABJZG... consistent with A. actinomycetemcomitans. confirmed.

provenance_quote: PrtA, which shows homology to the Erwinia chrysanthemi metalloproteases, is efficiently secreted by E. coli cells carrying the E. chrysanthemi ABC exporter PrtD (ABC protein)-PrtE (MFP)-PrtF (OMP).
notes: UniProt Q07295 = Serralysin A / PrtA (ProA), Dickeya chrysanthemi B374, Secreted metalloprotease with C-terminal secretion signal; organism matches ledger. DOI 10.1128/jb.179.15.4754-4760.1997 = PMID 9244262 (Akatsuka 1997); E. chrysanthemi PrtA secreted via PrtDEF ABC exporter (T1SS). Quote verbatim. Locus WCU84_RS14645 / NZ_JBBBOO... consistent with Dickeya. confirmed.
